yaml:
format: 3
vars:
  spec_version: "2026-10-24.3"
  timeout_seconds: 60
  refresh_margin_seconds: 120
  tenant: oregonpsilocybinprodb2c
  b2c: "https://{{tenant}}.b2clogin.com/{{tenant}}.onmicrosoft.com"
  site: "https://psilocybin.oregon.gov/"
flows:
  login:
    - id: ids
      type: generate
      make: random_hex
      into: [state]
    - id: page
      type: open_browser
      url: "{{b2c}}/authorize"
      params: {state: "{{state}}"}
      until: "{{site}}"
      extract:
        - {var: code, source: url_fragment, name: code}
        - {var: returned_state, source: url_fragment, name: state}
    - id: same_state
      type: assert
      require:
        - {check: vars_equal, vars: [state, returned_state], reason: structure, error: "the state did not match"}
    - id: token
      type: request
      method: POST
      url: "{{b2c}}/token"
      form: {code: "{{code}}"}
      extract:
        - {var: access_token, source: body, json: access_token}
  renew:
    - id: token
      type: request
      method: POST
      url: "{{b2c}}/token"
      form: {grant_type: refresh_token, refresh_token: "{{refresh_token}}"}
      extract:
        - {var: access_token, source: body, json: access_token}
